# Submit data to EKHI

[EKHI](/data/ekhi.html) indexes curve-level optical and thermal radiative property data with explicit provenance. Submissions are received by the editorial board and forwarded to the EKHI maintainers (Thermomat group, EHU), who decide on inclusion; every accepted dataset remains traceable to its source publication and credits its authors.

```{=html}
<div class="form-alt">
  Prefer email? Send the same information to
  <a href="mailto:info@emissivity.org?subject=EKHI%20data%20submission">info@emissivity.org</a>
  — every submission, by form or by mail, is reviewed by the editorial board
  before publication.
</div>

<form class="c-form" name="submit-data" method="POST" action="/contribute/thanks.html"
      data-netlify="true" netlify-honeypot="bot-field">
  <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="submit-data" />
  <p style="display:none"><label>Leave empty: <input name="bot-field" /></label></p>
  <label class="req" for="f-doi">Source publication DOI</label>
  <input id="f-doi" name="doi" type="text" required />
  <div class="hint">EKHI is publication-centred: data must trace to a published source</div>
  <label class="req" for="f-material">Material(s)</label>
  <input id="f-material" name="material" type="text" required />
  <div class="hint">e.g. polycrystalline SiC; α-Al₂O₃ ⟨0001⟩</div>
  <label class="req" for="f-property">Property / quantity</label>
  <input id="f-property" name="property" type="text" required />
  <div class="hint">e.g. normal spectral emissivity; hemispherical reflectance</div>
  <label class="req" for="f-temperature">Temperature</label>
  <input id="f-temperature" name="temperature" type="text" required />
  <div class="hint">In kelvin — a single value or a range, e.g. 1200 K; 300–1800 K</div>
  <label class="req" for="f-spectral_range">Spectral variable and range</label>
  <input id="f-spectral_range" name="spectral_range" type="text" required />
  <div class="hint">Wavelength or wavenumber, with unit — e.g. 2–25 µm; 400–5000 cm⁻¹</div>
  <label class="req" for="f-geometry">Measurement geometry</label>
  <input id="f-geometry" name="geometry" type="text" required />
  <div class="hint">Incidence / emission angle and collection — directional or hemispherical, e.g. normal (0°), directional; 8° incidence, hemispherical collection</div>
  <label for="f-uncertainty">Standard uncertainty</label>
  <input id="f-uncertainty" name="uncertainty" type="text" />
  <div class="hint">As stated in the source, with coverage factor if given (e.g. 0.02, k = 1) — or "none reported"</div>
  <label for="f-file_format">Preferred file format</label>
  <select id="f-file_format" name="file_format">
    <option value="">— choose —</option>
    <option value="csv">Tabular CSV</option>
    <option value="json">JSON</option>
  </select>
  <label for="f-conditions">Other conditions</label>
  <textarea id="f-conditions" name="conditions"></textarea>
  <div class="hint">Atmosphere or vacuum, surface finish, specimen notes</div>
  <label class="req" for="f-data_location">Where the data lives</label>
  <textarea id="f-data_location" name="data_location" required></textarea>
  <div class="hint">Link to files (Zenodo, institutional repository, supplementary material) or note that you will email them</div>

  <label class="req" for="s-name">Your name</label>
  <input id="s-name" name="submitter_name" required />
  <label class="req" for="s-email">Your email</label>
  <input id="s-email" name="submitter_email" type="email" required />
  <label for="s-aff">Affiliation</label>
  <input id="s-aff" name="submitter_affiliation" />
  <button type="submit">Submit for review</button>
</form>
```

:::
